result.title: Value or Attention: Investigating Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for Graph Attention Networks
result.comment: Accepted at the XAI4Science Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 17 pages, 9 figures
result.summary: Graph Attention Networks (GATs) are increasingly used in domains where scientists need to read a model's reasoning, from medicine to materials science, yet the routing they learn remains opaque to most explainers. Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) follows the model's computation, but in an attention layer the relevance reaching a node is the sum of two mechanically different quantities: its content relevance through the value path and its routing relevance through the attention path. Existing rules either drop one or add them into a single number. We write a single product rule with free weights on the two factors that recovers current approaches as special cases. The value path measures what content a node supplied against a zero baseline; the attention path measures how the node shaped what was passed relative to its neighborhood, and its sign records whether the node's features moved the gating the way the prediction demanded. On a ground-truth classification task, we show that the same node receives negative, positive and near-zero relevance under three settings of the rule. The separated relevance maps yield a hypothesis about the model: it gains by not reading that node. We give reading rules for both paths and argue that they should be interpreted separately.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文针对 Graph Attention Network 的层级相关性传播（LRP），将节点获得的相关性拆成 value 路径的内容贡献与 attention 路径的路由贡献，用一个带自由权重的乘积规则统一现有做法，并在有真值的分类任务上展示同一节点在三种设置下可获得负、正或近零相关性。
AI.relevance_reason: 把「内容贡献」与「注意力/路由贡献」分开归因并解释符号方向，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容与实际被使用的视觉证据之间的贡献分配和筛选诊断提供可核查的迁移线索。
